Community COVID-19 rates per 100,000 population were calculated for each of the ten HHS regions
Among residents, cases per 1,000 resident-weeks increased during June and July, reaching 11.5 cases per 1,000 resident-weeks
Community COVID-19 rates per 100,000 population were calculated for each of the ten HHS regions
Rates of COVID-19 among nursing home residents and staff members increased during June and July 2020
Although incidence among residents (10.5 cases per 1,000 resident-weeks) was higher than that among staff members (8.9 per 1,000 resident-weeks) on May 31
For each HHS region, trends in nursing home incidence among residents and staff members were similar to population trends in the surrounding community.
This report uses the NHSN nursing home COVID-19 data reported during May 25–November 22, 2020
Rates of COVID-19 in the surrounding communities followed similar trends.

methods_quotes.q: Cases per 1,000 resident-week were calculated for residents and staff members using the number of COVID-19 cases reported in a week
Community COVID-19 rates per 100,000 population were calculated for each of the ten HHS regions
Rates among residents and staff members and in the surrounding community were compared by HHS region.
Facilities were excluded from the analysis for specific weeks if data on cases, occupied beds, or staffing were not reported.
